name: Heaven's Secret 2
source:
I died and found myself in the world of angels and demons. Immortality gave me power and might, but a force is coming that will take everything from me. 

I thought I had reached the end of my path, but it was only the beginning.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Heaven%27s_Secret_2]romance-club.fandom[/url]
